title: AES-ECB 加密参数：生成测试并定位模式误用
input_source:
from Crypto.Cipher import AES
from Crypto.Util.Padding import pad
import os

key = os.urandom(32)

def encrypt_params(params: bytes) -> bytes:
    cipher = AES.new(key, AES.MODE_ECB)
    ct = cipher.encrypt(pad(params, AES.block_size))
    return ct

if __name__ == '__main__':
    data = b'rate=0.08;years=10'
    encrypted = encrypt_params(data)
    print(encrypted.hex())

findings.fix: 改用 AES.GCM 或 AES.CBC 并生成不可预测 nonce，使用 secrets 或 os.urandom 生成 nonce，并在解密时验证 nonce。

import hashlib
import hmac

SYNTHETIC_SALT = b"SYNTHETIC_ACCT_SALT_001"

def derive_report_key(passphrase: str) -> bytes:
    return hashlib.md5((passphrase + SYNTHETIC_SALT.decode()).encode()).digest()

def sign_report(payload: bytes, key: bytes) -> str:
    return hmac.new(key, payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

# 验证MD5用于派生报告密钥
key1 = derive_report_key("SYNTHETIC_PASSPHRASE")
key2 = derive_report_key("SYNTHETIC_PASSPHRASE")
assert key1 == key2, "相同密钥应派生相同报告密钥"

# 验证MD5对输入敏感
key3 = derive_report_key("DIFFERENT_PASSPHRASE")
assert key1 != key3, "不同密钥应派生不同报告密钥"

# 验证MD5输出长度
assert len(key1) == 16, "MD5输出应为16字节"

# 验证sign_report使用HMAC-SHA256
payload = b"synthetic report"
key = derive_report_key("SYNTHETIC_PASSPHRASE")
sig = sign_report(payload, key)
assert len(sig) == 64, "HMAC-SHA256输出应为64字符"

print("All tests passed: MD5用于派生报告密钥，sign_report使用HMAC-SHA256。")

import hashlib
import hmac

SYNTHETIC_SALT = b"SYNTHETIC_ACCT_SALT_001"

def derive_report_key_fixed(passphrase: str) -> bytes:
    return hashlib.sha256((passphrase + SYNTHETIC_SALT.decode()).encode()).digest()

def sign_report_fixed(payload: bytes, key: bytes) -> str:
    return hmac.new(key, payload, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

# 验证派生密钥
key1 = derive_report_key_fixed("SYNTHETIC_PASSPHRASE")
key2 = derive_report_key_fixed("SYNTHETIC_PASSPHRASE")
assert key1 == key2, "相同密钥应派生相同报告密钥"

key3 = derive_report_key_fixed("DIFFERENT_PASSPHRASE")
assert key1 != key3, "不同密钥应派生不同报告密钥"

assert len(key1) == 32, "SHA-256输出应为32字节"

# 验证签名
payload = b"synthetic report"
key = derive_report_key_fixed("SYNTHETIC_PASSPHRASE")
sig = sign_report_fixed(payload, key)
assert len(sig) == 64, "HMAC-SHA256输出应为64字符"

print("Fixed tests passed: SHA-256派生报告密钥，sign_report使用HMAC-SHA256。")
